rules.text: Owner manages keys, transfer and closure. Admin can manage ordinary resources, billing and Activity. Member can read ordinary resources.
rules.why: Permissions follow the acting principal in the selected organisation.

rules.text: An Admin cannot manage another Admin or take ownership by editing a role.
rules.instead: Use the Owner’s personal session and the ownership transfer workflow.

rules.text: Use invitations to grant access to the same business resources. Review team activity under the relevant organisation.
Choose the permitted role when inviting a colleague. The recipient claims the invitation.
An ordinary Member cannot write business resources. Leaving a team is a personal membership action.
Read the current context before rendering controls. Retrieve the member list only with the required permission.
On permission_denied show the refusal and ask the appropriate organisation role to act.
